issues.title: Fake event harness: src/lib/fakes.ts + /dev page
issues.body:
## Goal
Each lane can build and demo its part alone, by firing the other lanes' events from a dev page. This unblocks all of M1.

Plan ref: PLAN.md §8 ("Build against fake events until integration")

## Steps
- `src/lib/fakes.ts`: one builder per event in `MasterGEvents` with realistic payloads (cluster PNGs from `benchmark/samples/`, a verdict of each status/mark/hint rung, writeNote, userUtterance, questionConfirmed of each kind).
- `/dev` page: a button per fake, a scripted sequence button (the fraction golden path as a timed event list), and a live log of every bus event.
- Dev-only: return 404 in production like `/api/samples`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every event in `src/lib/types.ts` can be fired from `/dev` (checked by clicking each in Chrome).
- [ ] The golden-path sequence plays the PLAN.md §11 fraction story as events, visible in the log.
- [ ] `npm run check` exits 0. No change to `types.ts`/`bus.ts`, or if needed, approved by another owner.

## Notes
- Assigned to Sarthak because the benchmark waits on samples anyway. Do this while Harjeet captures them.
- Cut rule: the scripted sequence can come after the single buttons.

---
Context: `PLAN.md` (product), `AGENTS.md` (workflow, lanes, honesty rules). Branch `<name>/<issue#>-<topic>`, PR with `Closes #N`, self-merge when `npm run check` is green.

issues.title: Capture ~48 labelled benchmark samples on the stylus board
issues.body:
## Goal
A shared, labelled set of real stylus handwriting so the benchmark decides the pipeline from data.

Plan ref: PLAN.md §7 Samples

## Steps
- Whoever has the stylus board: `npm run dev` → http://localhost:3000/capture.
- Write 10 fractions, 10 linear equations, 10 BODMAS/decimals, 10 LCM/HCF, 8 word-problem steps. About half with a typical mistake. Include deliberately messy digits (1/7, 4/9, 5/S).
- Label each: expected text (mathjs syntax), correct/wrong, category.
- Commit `benchmark/samples/` on a branch and open a PR.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `benchmark/samples/labels.json` has ≥ 48 entries, each with a PNG that exists.
- [ ] ≥ 20 samples are wrong steps and ≥ 20 are correct; ≥ 6 have deliberately ambiguous digits.
- [ ] Merged to `main` so Sarthak's benchmark run uses it.

## Notes
- Blocks: the benchmark spike. Do this first.
- Polish `/capture` only if it slows you down.

---
Context: `PLAN.md` (product), `AGENTS.md` (workflow, lanes, honesty rules). Branch `<name>/<issue#>-<topic>`, PR with `Closes #N`, self-merge when `npm run check` is green.

issues.title: Spike: run the pipeline benchmark and call the winner
issues.body:
## Goal
Pick the step-judging pipeline (A / A+guard / B / C / C+guard / D) by the rule agreed before seeing results.

Plan ref: PLAN.md §7

## Steps
- `npm run bench:models`, then set `GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL` / `GEMINI_PRO_MODEL` in `.env.local` if the defaults aren't listed.
- Smoke run: `npm run bench -- --limit 5`, then the full run: `npm run bench -- --repeat 2`.
- Fill the table in `docs/SPIKES.md` → *Spike: pipeline benchmark*; link the report in `benchmark/results/`.
- Eyeball the diagnosis quality (categories) in the report.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Decision rule applied as written: the fastest config with **0 false alarms, ≥ 95 % verdict accuracy, ≤ 2 s p95**, or a documented fallback if none qualifies.
- [ ] Results table and decision in `docs/SPIKES.md`, decision row in `docs/DECISIONS.md`.
- [ ] n ≥ 48 samples × 2 repeats. Number of calls logged in the ledger.

## Notes
- Depends on: the sample capture issue.
- If nothing passes: pick the config with 0 false alarms and the best accuracy, and widen benefit-of-the-doubt. Record it as an accepted risk.

> **API cost:** this makes Gemini calls. Check your quota in AI Studio first and log bulk runs in the ledger in `docs/SPIKES.md`.

---

issues.title: Spike: echo test + Masterji voice audition
issues.body:
## Goal
Decide hands-free vs stage mode (push-to-talk) and pick Masterji's voice, on the real laptop speakers.

Plan ref: PLAN.md §2 Voice, §6 Echo

## Steps
- Minimal Live API page: mic with `echoCancellation: true`, speaker output.
- Audition 3–4 male, older-sounding prebuilt voices with the same Hinglish lines ("Arre beta, line 2 dobara dekho").
- Echo test: Masterji speaks through the speakers in a noisy room. Does he hear himself and stop or reply to himself?

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Voice picked from ≥ 3 auditioned, recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md` with the model name.
- [ ] Echo result: 5 tries hands-free on speakers. Pass = 0 self-interruptions, else stage mode becomes the demo default. Written in `docs/SPIKES.md`.
- [ ] Model name and API version recorded (needed for the Gemini prize write-up).

> **API cost:** this makes Gemini calls. Check your quota in AI Studio first and log bulk runs in the ledger in `docs/SPIKES.md`.

issues.title: Spike: stroke clustering on real stylus input
issues.body:
## Goal
Prove strokes group into one cluster per written step (space + time), because every AI mark lands on a cluster bbox.

Plan ref: PLAN.md §4 Stroke clusters

## Steps
- On the canvas (or a throwaway page), group strokes by bbox proximity + time gap. Draw each cluster's bbox.
- Write a 4-line fraction chain and a 4-line equation, at normal and messy spacing.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 10/10 lines → exactly one cluster each, with no merges across lines, on the real stylus board in Chrome.
- [ ] Thresholds and screenshots in `docs/SPIKES.md` → *Spike: clustering*.

## Notes
- If line-merging fails: fall back to y-band clustering on the ruled lines.

---

issues.title: Step judging: /api/step + brain service (cluster → Flash → checker → verdict)
issues.milestone: M1 Lanes: build against fake events
issues.body:
## Goal
The core loop: each `clusterUpdated` becomes a `verdict` within ~2 s, and never calls a correct step wrong.

Plan ref: PLAN.md §5

## Steps
- Server route `/api/step` (key stays server-side) runs the benchmark's winning config with `stepPrompt.ts`.
- Client brain service: listens to `clusterUpdated`, orders clusters top-to-bottom, passes `previous` + `question` context to `checkReadings` (benefit of the doubt).
- Checker wins whenever it can compute. Emits `verdict` with `source`.
- Drop stale responses (cluster changed or removed while in flight).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Replay all benchmark samples through the service offline: 0 false alarms (script output in the PR).
- [ ] Pen pause → verdict p95 ≤ 2 s measured on 20 real calls, numbers in the PR.
- [ ] Works with Voice and Notebook absent (driven from `/dev`).

> **API cost:** this makes Gemini calls. Check your quota in AI Studio first and log bulk runs in the ledger in `docs/SPIKES.md`.

---
Context: `PLAN.md` (product), `AGENTS.md` (workflow, lanes, honesty rules). Branch `<name>/<issue#>-<topic>`, PR with `Closes #N`, self-merge when `npm run check` is green.

issues.title: Mistake memory: growing categories, repeatCount, hint-rung state
issues.milestone: M1 Lanes: build against fake events
issues.body:
## Goal
Masterji remembers mistakes within the session. "Phir se wahi galti!" fires deterministically and hints climb the ladder.

Plan ref: PLAN.md §2 Hint ladder, §5 Mistake memory

## Steps
- Session store: seed categories + ones created mid-session (id + Hinglish label). Pass the list to Flash every call and require reuse.
- `repeatCount` per category. `hintRung` per open mistake: +1 per failed retry or "nahi pata" (via `userUtterance`), reset on fix.
- Fixed cluster → verdict `correct` (Voice praises the effort).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Unit test: the same category twice → `repeatCount` 2; four failed retries → rungs 1, 2, 3, 4.
- [ ] Category list is in every Flash call (logged in dev).

---

issues.title: Masterji persona prompt: guardrails, hint ladder, Hinglish/English, verdict turns
issues.milestone: M1 Lanes: build against fake events
issues.body:
## Goal
Masterji sounds like a strict, funny, caring tuition teacher and only ever speaks from verdicts. He never judges math himself.

Plan ref: PLAN.md §2 (persona, guardrails, hint ladder), §5 ("Only ever receives verdicts as hidden text")

## Steps
- System prompt: persona, signature lines, the 4 guardrails (one dramatic line max, banned words, praise effort, soften after 3+ mistakes), and rung phrasing.
- On `verdict` (wrong) → send a hidden text turn like `[cluster 3 WRONG, add_across, rung 1, repeat 2]`. Correct → silent.
- Greeting asks the kid's name and uses it. Read back the question for confirmation.
- Language switch changes the speaking language mid-session.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 10 fake wrong verdicts from `/dev`: 0 banned words, ≤ 1 dramatic line each, rung phrasing matches PLAN §2 (transcript in the PR).
- [ ] repeatCount ≥ 2 → "Phir se wahi galti" or equivalent in 5/5 tries.

---
